primitives.verbatim_quote: on | Inert until 200+ fired bets clear breakeven | **BUILT INERT**: accountability-as-Bayesian-precision weighting (coin-flip channels earn exactly 0; fusion with no earned weight says NOTHING), ACI update, Learn-then-Test with fire-nothing as a first-class outcome.

primitives.name: Honesty Engine Calibration
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Honesty engine**: OOF calibration (beta tails + isotonic middle + monotone envelope, Brier-decomposition selection), logit-pool β falsification test, Mondrian Venn-Abers selective gate (LCB(e)>τ, disjoint-fold tuning), fractional Kelly + James-Stein haircut + Ledoit-Wolf + CLV deflator (stakes exactly 0 below 50 settled), display guard (coverage+LCB+CLV+provenance or it throws).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{L}(\\theta)': 'Brier loss function (dimensionless)', 'p_i': 'predicted probability (dimensionless)', 'y_i': 'actual outcome (0 or 1)', 'n': 'number of predictions (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Predictions must be calibrated using out-of-fold methods; falsification tests ensure robustness.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when predictions are overconfident or misaligned with empirical outcomes.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSI's core calibration kernel with added falsification and risk-adjustment layers.
layer2.telemetry: Calibration curve deviation and Brier score

primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Glass Ledger**: append-only hash chain (publish-before-kickoff structural), gated anchor payload builder (zero network even when enabled), open `recompute.ts` verifier, `/glass-ledger` surface behind PUBLISH_LEDGER (default OFF, all-picks default, calibration-led, zero fabricated numbers) — mounted BESIDE the live Trust Ledger, which this build does not touch.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'H_n': 'hash of block n (SHA-256)', 'H_{n-1}': 'hash of previous block (SHA-256)', 'M_n': 'message content of block n (bytes)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each block is cryptographically linked to the previous one; no modification allowed post-insertion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Tampering detected through hash mismatch; integrity preserved via immutability.

layer2.telemetry: Hash consistency check and block sequence validation
